about: Advisory diagnostics; correctness and disciplinary conventions take priority. No universal word quotas or sentence ceiling. Project overrides are supported.

banned.label: delve
banned.fix: Use the specific action: analyze, compare, estimate or test.

banned.label: empty praise
banned.fix: State the supported novelty or comparison with its scope.

banned.label: empty emphasis
banned.pattern: \b(?:it is worth noting that|needless to say|plays a pivotal role|underscores the importance of)\b
banned.fix: State the object and supported claim directly.

banned.label: generic promise
banned.pattern: \b(?:paves? the way|opens? new avenues|unlocks? the potential|expand(?:s)? the horizons)\b
banned.fix: Name the specific implication and what remains untested.

banned_openers.label: vague paratext
banned_openers.fix: State the finding, question or concrete scope.

advisory.label: blanket importance
advisory.fix: Check context: statistical significance and domain-specific technical meanings are legitimate.

manual: Assess clarity, logical qualification and paragraph purpose in context.
Preserve measured conditions, uncertainty and necessary technical terms.
